title: Four South Asian countries formalise a heat cooperation framework
summary: A secondary web report says India, Nepal, Bangladesh and Bhutan formalised a regional coalition on heat in October 2026.

review.note: Established sources describe four country assessments released at the Global Heat Forum, not a formal coalition. Held until an official source confirms one.
